newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian c. bank says need for caution in rupiah.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian c. bank says need for caution in rupiah.

text.p: Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Thursday further caution was needed despite a marginal improvement in rupiah rates.

"I think the situation has improved on Wednesday. I hope it will continue to do so. We are living in an area which is a target of speculative attack. We have to remain vigilant and not become careless," Djiwandono told reporters.
Djiwandono was responding to a recent steep fall in the rupiah following speculative attacks on currencies in the region.
"We hope the good rupiah management will get support from banks and the business world," Djiwandono said.

"If things have settled down and a new equilibrium has been found, let us continue ... so that the system we have built up cannot be rattled so easily. We have a good result so far but we have to remain cautious," Djiwandono said.
